text:
ana_partnerships: quick thread to finalize the SI co-sell handoff rules for the marketplace + hw partner launch. goal = no stalled leads and a clear ops flow. quick thoughts?

sam_sales: Two things: 1) define SI-introduced vs marketplace lead. 2) what's the SLA to claim?

mike_se: Proposal: SI-introduced = partner intro email OR fastpass token. fastpass valid = 72h. Claim windows: hot (demo/POC) = 48h, warm = 72h. Tag leads with partner_origin, si_name, listing_id.

rachel_ps: Marketing needs a 1-pager + short outreach templates. Also request an "SI-enabled" badge for the listing. Legal will need to sign off on logos.

jordan_ops: Ops plan: add fields partner_score, fastpass_token, marketplace_listing_id, co_sell_credit_pct; add an "SI claimed" status; alert #partner-triage on expiry. Webhook sent to SI POC on claim.

claire_si_poc: From SI side: 72h fastpass ok. we need the webhook to include a short orientation link + contact. physical demo kits need >=72h prep — flag those as hw_tag=true.

mike_se: compact routing pseudo: 
```
if (fastpass_valid) -> route=si-immediate (claim=72h)
else if (partner_score>=70 && tier==enterprise) -> route=si-priority (claim=48h)
else if (hw_tag && tier!=small) -> route=hw-si-first (claim=48h)
else -> route=hosted-first (claim=72h)
```

ana_partnerships: Decisions: fastpass 72h, default co_sell_credit_pct=20% (overrides per partner profile), LOA required for co-billing > $50k. Next actions: sam compile overrides; mike finalize routing table; rachel draft enablement; jordan prototype webhook. Sync Mon 10am PT. :thumbsup:
